notes: LaunchToken sets its name and symbol to HONGBAO. HongbaoBox is an ownerless IMD red-packet contract configured with the supplied IMD token, independent of LaunchToken. No initialization calls are required. Lucky-packet creators can choose between revealing and allowing equal fallback settlement; Robinhood Chain's sequencer orders transactions. The factory supplies the liquidity pool, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard.
